title: 第一卷 第14章 超级怪物
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“停下吧，自己拿点吃的和喝的，吃饱喝足，去把你的木屋开过来！”

秦龙看到丧尸已经不再出现了，看着纣文慧疲惫的样子喊道。

本来想将纣文慧放出去，还在原来的路上。

这样也算是能够多收集一些物资。

但转念一想，纣文慧的这个天赋，就像是一个雷达一样。

这对于自己来说，绝对是一个大助力。

带在身边，才是最好的利用。

况且，这是自己的第一个附属木屋，跟着自己的四级木屋，才是最安全的。

两个人一起出门，更加安全一点，毕竟她是不能背叛自己的那种，连想杀自己也做不到。

“好的，谢谢秦大哥！”

纣文慧闻言，终于一下子坐在了地上。

从刚才收集的物资里面拿出了水和面包吃了起来。

是真的饿了。

秦龙看了一下击杀丧尸得到物资。

现在都在纣文慧的空间之中。

水，二十五瓶。

面包，十五块。

自热火锅，三盒。

菜刀，一把。

丫哈哈，一排。

非常可乐，三瓶。

高能燃烧液体，两个。

华子，两盒！

看着五花八门的东西，秦始都快乐开花了。

没别的，就是那两盒华子！

他可是非常爱这一口。

可惜从进入这个世界，昨天到现在，是一口没整到。

现在，丧尸竟然爆这种东西。

简直不要太爽。

下一秒，两盒华子已经出现在了秦龙的手中。

抽出一根，用打火机点上。

红色的火苗，像是重新点燃了秦龙的一切。

有这东西，似乎一切都不重要了。

秦龙直接连抽了两根。

两根之后，才将这东西谨慎地收了起来。

天知道下一次爆出来这东西要到什么时候。

以后交易平台之上要好好看看了。

或许有人爆出这东西会拿来交换。

老烟枪就不用指望了，肯定第一时间就自己藏起来了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Stop, get yourself some food and drink, eat and drink enough, go and bring your cabin over!"

Qin Long saw that the zombies no longer appeared, and looked at Zhou Wenhui's tired look and shouted.

I originally wanted to release Zhou Wenhui, but he was still on his original path.

This can be considered as being able to collect more supplies.

But then I thought about it, Zhou Wenhui's talent was like a radar.

This is definitely a big help for myself.

Taking it with you is the best use.

Besides, this is my first attached wooden house, and it is the safest to follow my fourth-level wooden house.

It's safer for two people to go out together. After all, she is the kind of person who can't betray him. She can't even kill herself.

"Okay, thank you, Brother Qin!"

After hearing this, Zhou Wenhui finally sat down on the ground.

I took out water and bread from the supplies I had just collected and ate them.

I'm really hungry.

Qin Long looked at the supplies obtained by killing zombies.

Now they are all in Zhou Wenhui's space.

Water, twenty-five bottles.

Bread, fifteen pieces.

Self-heating hot pot, three boxes.

A kitchen knife.

Yahaha, one row.

Very Coke, three bottles.

High energy burning liquid, two.

Huazi, two boxes!

Looking at all kinds of things, Qin Shi felt happy.

Nothing else, just those two boxes of Huazi!

He loved this bite very much.

It's a pity that since entering this world, from yesterday to now, I haven't been able to get through it at all.

Now, zombies actually explode this kind of thing.

It’s simply not too fun.

The next second, two boxes of Huazi appeared in Qin Long's hands.

Pull one out and light it with a lighter.

The red flames seemed to rekindle everything about Qin Long.

With this thing, everything seems to be unimportant.

Qin Long took two cigarettes in a row.

After two sticks, the thing was carefully put away.

God knows when this thing will come out next.

We need to take a closer look at the trading platform in the future.

Maybe someone will trade it if they find out about it.

There is no need to count on the old smoker, he will definitely hide it himself as soon as possible.
